thread:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — Kettlepoint is planning a phased rollout to three new product teams (search, recommendations, and support summarization). They told us in today's check-in they expect ~40 req/s steady during peak, up from 6 req/s currently. They're asking about Dedicated vs. Hosted burst for predictable latency.

Oliver Park: awesome signal. Any timeline for the rollout?

Maya Chen: Q2 start, small canary in week 2 then ramp over 6 weeks. Also asked about SLA for embeddings and whether we can pin model versions across teams.

Ravi Singh: +1 on model pinning. For embeddings throughput, if they're doing vector search for 3 teams concurrently I'd recommend Dedicated with autoscale and prefix caching. Need to validate payload sizes — do we have sample qps and token counts?

Maya Chen: here's the quick numbers from their PM:
```
- Current: 6 req/s, avg 120 tokens/response
- Peak projected: 40 req/s, avg 200 tokens/response
- Embedding batch jobs: daily 2M vectors, ingest window overnight (2AM-6AM PST)
```

Ravi Singh: thanks. Rough back-of-envelope: 40 req/s @200 tokens => ~16000 tokens/s. With typical batching and a quantized model we can serve that on 2 x A10G-equivalent GPUs for generation if latency SLO is 300ms p95. Embedding ingestion can be done on a separate dedicated pool or queued to non-peak. I'll put together a more precise capacity estimate.

InfraBot: Region us-west-2 capacity check: 2 dedicated pools free (gpu-pool-09, gpu-pool-12). Estimated time to provision: 48-72 hours.

Oliver Park: good. Maya — can you confirm whether Kettlepoint has compliance constraints? If they need VPC/private deployment that changes process and timelines.

Maya Chen: they do want VPC but not air-gapped. Kettlepoint security: SOC2 in scope, want KMS integration and retention controls. Also their procurement asked about committedReserved pricing for Dedicated.

Oliver Park: solid renewal opportunity. I'll draft a renewal/expansion play after Ravi's capacity ask. Can @Ravi and Maya sync on a 30-min sizing call tomorrow?

Ravi Singh: available 10:30am PT. I'll bring sample perf runs and suggested quantization options. Also propose an enablement workshop for their infra and SRE — 1.5 hours covering traffic shaping, cache, and burst configs.

Maya Chen: scheduled 10:30am PT — I'll invite the Kettlepoint PM and their infra lead. I'll also upload the sample payloads to the shared folder before the call.

QBRBot: Reminder set: Kettlepoint QBR created for 2026-04-05. Linked doc: https://redwood.company/qbrs/kettlepoint

Oliver Park: next steps: 1) Ravi to post capacity estimate and cost delta (hosted vs dedicated) by EOD tomorrow. 2) Maya to confirm compliance knobs required. 3) I'll prepare commercial terms and committed pricing options. Nice signal — looks like expansion plus renewal acceleration. :rocket:
